title: Go-live Readiness Scorecard and Blocker Log (draft)
body:
Purpose:
This working doc is a lightweight scorecard + blocker log intended for customer success managers and solutions engineers to (1) track implementation milestones for inference rollouts, (2) quickly assess go-live readiness across SLO/security/integration axes, and (3) surface renewal risk indicators before QBRs.

How to use:
- Maintain one row per milestone; update status weekly ahead of syncs.
- Use the readiness score to flag accounts requiring escalation (score <= 60).
- Log blockers with an owner and mitigation ETA; escalate urgent items to Solutions Eng or SRE.

Key definitions (quick):
- Milestone: Discrete activity required for production inference (examples below).
- Readiness score: 0-100 composite (integration completeness, SLO acceptance, security review, performance verification).
- Blocker severity: P0 (critical, stops go-live), P1 (high, must resolve pre-rollout), P2 (medium), P3 (low).

Milestone rows (copy into CS tracker):
- Customer kickoff (owner, date): Owner: CSM. Acceptance: kickoff slides + action items recorded. Typical time: day 0.
- Network & VPC peering (owner, date): Owner: Solutions Eng / Customer NetOps. Acceptance: Verified connectivity, IP allowlist, egress rules. Typical time: 2-10 days.
- Auth & secrets (owner, date): Owner: Customer/CSM. Acceptance: API key exchange or KMS binding test.
- Model selection & slicing (owner, date): Owner: Applied ML / Customer. Acceptance: Selected model variant, quantization decision, expected latency profile.
- Test dataset & evals (owner, date): Owner: Customer + Solutions Eng. Acceptance: Baseline evals, quality threshold met (or documented regression).
- Performance bench (owner, date): Owner: Performance Eng. Acceptance: 95p latency, throughput targets verified on representative load.
- KV/prefix caching plan (owner, date): Owner: Customer / Solutions Eng. Acceptance: Cache rules defined and smoke-tested.
- Traceability & observability (owner, date): Owner: Observability team / CSM. Acceptance: Dashboards configured (latency/cost/error), alert thresholds set.
- Rollout policy & fallback (owner, date): Owner: Product/CS. Acceptance: Canary percent plan, fallback model defined.
- Security & compliance signoff (owner, date): Owner: Security COP / Customer Sec. Acceptance: SOC2 checklist, encryption, audit logs validated.
- Go/no-go review (owner, date): Owner: CSM + Solutions Eng + Customer. Acceptance: Signed go-live note + scheduled launch window.

Sample readiness matrix (copyable):
- Integration completeness: 0-40 points (API auth, network, data pipeline).
- SLO acceptance: 0-30 points (latency/throughput verified).
- Quality & evals: 0-15 points (pass/fail on prioritized prompts).
- Compliance/security: 0-10 points (signed checklist).
- Observability: 0-5 points (dashboards/alerts active).

Scoring guidance:
- >=85: Green — ready for scheduled go-live; monitor only.
- 70-84: Yellow — minor items to resolve; consider short dry-run.
- 50-69: Orange — significant items; schedule pre-go technical run.
- <=49: Red — blocker(s) present; do not proceed until resolved.

Blocker log template (one line per blocker):
- Blocker ID: BL-<short-num>
- Description: short sentence
- Severity: P0/P1/P2/P3
- Impact area: network|auth|performance|quality|compliance|observability
- Owner: name + role
- Mitigation plan: 1-2 lines
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
- Escalation contact: person/team + channel (e.g., #sre-oncall)

Common real-world blockers (examples):
- Customer proxy strips chunked transfer-encoding causing streaming failure (P0). Mitigation: temporary batch mode, engineering patch required; ETA 3 business days.
- KMS policy prevents Redwood connector from using encryption keys (P1). Mitigation: short policy change + audit; ETA 5 days.
- Evaluations show 7% quality regression on key prompts post-quantization (P1). Mitigation: rollback to float variant for canary; plan tuning run.

Renewal risk flags (to surface pre-QBR):
- Repeated missed milestones (>=2 missed dates)
- Performance delta >20% vs expectation on representative load
- Security signoff delay >30 days after kickoff
- Multiple P0 blockers in the 30 days before intended go-live
- Low usage of staging endpoints 7 days after handoff (indicates lack of engagement)

QBR talking points (short bullets for CSM):
- Health summary: readiness score + top 3 blockers
- Timeline: confirmed go-live window and rollback plan
- Cost/throughput expectations: validated perf numbers + any planned optimizations (quantization, batching)
- Renewal risk and mitigation ask (e.g., exec sponsor meeting, top escalation)
- Ops handoff: who owns post-go monitoring and playbook link

Handover checklist (post go-live):
- Post-launch incidence review scheduled (72 hours)
- Runbook for common issues documented in customer playbook
- Baseline cost/latency reports captured for 14-day comparison
- Optional: plan for phased traffic increase (0-10-50-100%)

Next steps for the CSM using this doc:
1) Copy the milestone rows into the customer-specific tracker and assign owners.
2) Run go/no-go scoring 7 days before planned window and again 24 hours prior.
3) If readiness score <= 60 at 7-day check, request engineering dry-run and escalate to solutions eng manager.
4) Add any discovered blockers to the central blocker log and ping escalation channels.

Notes / open questions (working):
- Should we include a lightweight SLA acceptance signature template here, or keep signatures in the legal SOW? (P. Rao to advise)
- Can we automate readiness scoring from tracked boolean milestone fields in the CRM? Product ops stubbed a ticket (CS-5489).

Revision history:
- 2025-02-12 — initial draft (Ava P.)
- 2025-02-26 — added scoring guidance and sample blockers (Diego M.)
- 2025-03-03 — linked artifact updates + minor copy edits (Ava P.)

End of doc.
